false_success_rate_threshold_note: Deliberately unset. Requires a separate recorded decision. While null, the trust gate evaluates to UNKNOWN - never OK, never TRUST_FAIL.

trust.note: false_success_rate is an aggregate metric over a run set; a single run cannot decide it. Per-run this gate is UNKNOWN.
